faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes SL320/SL350 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation. Early R129 models (1989‑2002) use the M112 V6; the R230 (2001‑2012) used M112 and later M272; the R231 (2012‑2021) used M272 and later M276. Send us your registration and we’ll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes SL320/SL350 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200, for all three engine codes. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed‑price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SL320/SL350?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we’ll confirm whether you have the M112, M272 or M276 before you’re quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M112 SL320/SL350 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M112 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M272 SL320/SL350 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M272 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild M276 SL320/SL350 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M276 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used SL320/SL350 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low‑mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we’ve matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SL320/SL350 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SL320/SL350 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3‑5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SL320/SL350 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit’s history, and comes with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
